scope: Prepared archive-only parent/tree approach and independent read-only verification of its dated snapshot.
approach_review: One explicitly archive-only commit can retain all observed task histories through its32 parent pointers while using the exact final transfer tree. It requires one fixed archival ref and no source tree merge.

The first parent remains the final transfer commit; the31 additional independent tips belong to the same app repository. The commit message and receipt must describe retention, avoiding a claim that their code trees have been integrated.

Every ancestor commit, tree and blob reachable through those parents remains reachable through the archive branch. The retained86-ref mapping preserves the association between old names and exact tips.
The actual product main and protected feature/recovery refs remain outside the deletion set. This archive commit is never merged into product main.

The two native task refs are separate. Their history must be proven reachable from the accepted native main and handled by the publisher's native mode; app archive parent pointers cannot cross repositories.
independent_method: Compared preparation rows with the86-row retained API observation and exact reviewed-ref file.
Compared all86 names against the fixed accepted publisher allowlist; verified uniqueness and64 distinct observed commit tips.
Used three local read-only Git object commands with optional writes, lazy fetch and replacement objects disabled: exact transfer tree lookup, merge-base --independent, and rev-list of all32 parents.
Verified the precise32-parent set and all623 ancestry commits; every observed tip is in the complete parent closure.
No new Git objects, refs, worktrees, commit or deletion were created by this review.
required_actual_creation_and_acceptance: Refresh the exact86 live tip snapshot after the final transfer publications. The dated42f540 snapshot is already superseded by later transfer descendants and cannot authorize final creation/deletion.

Recompute the independent parents and exact final transfer tree from the refreshed immutable objects. The current publisher requires exactly32 unique parents with transfer first; a different count requires an explicit reviewed adjustment.

Create only refs/heads/archive/bead-editing-complete-20261127 if absent. Keep the actual created commit tree byte-identical to the final transfer tree and its ordered parents exactly the reviewed list.
Read back the actual commit object and remote fixed archive ref; independently prove all86 final observed tips are ancestors of that archive commit and retain the exact receipt/hash.

Prepare a separate actual archive review with accepted=true, all_refs_covered=true, archive_commit, archive_receipt_sha256 and the canonical digest of the final86 rows. This preparation review deliberately cannot satisfy that consumer gate.

Before deletion, the accepted publisher must reobserve exact main/archive/task refs, preserve local/index/config/hook state, and push only the fixed86 explicit deletions atomically with an expected-tip lease for every ref. Its after-read must show exact retained main/archive and no targeted refs.
Handle the two native refs independently with an accepted native-main ancestry receipt and unchanged exact main; leave main/feature/recovery refs untouched.
